clause: Layout grids & named grids + measurement systems [STU-LAY-052,STU-LAY-053]

scope.summary: Implement layout grids and named grids: character-count-based page grids and reusable frame-grid formats importable across documents for grid-based composition; named grids apply to text frames (MT-152). Implement measurement systems selectable per axis, including at least points, picas, inches, decimal inches, millimeters, centimeters, ciceros, agates, pixels, and a custom unit, cycled from the ruler or a units setting. Every length-bearing layout field MUST carry an explicit unit per the Studio unit law ([STU-DOC-003]); the document declares a default layout unit and mixed-unit fields are forbidden (validation gate).
acceptance_criteria: character-count/named grids importable + per-axis units incl custom; explicit-unit law enforced (mixed-unit forbidden)
proof_targets: named-grid import runtime; unit-law rejection test
expected_tests: live: named frame-grid format imports across documents + applies to a text frame
test: all enumerated units selectable per axis; mixed-unit field rejected by unit-law validation; default unit declared

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Layout grids & measurement units

risk_if_missed: No CJK/character grids; unit handling inconsistent; unit-law violations reach authority.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
